description: This file defines the ChartRepository class, a singleton responsible for managing a collection of chart identifiers within the UI module of the application. It provides methods for adding, retrieving, and clearing charts, as well as creating chart scroll controls and notifying listeners about digital chart events.

classes.name: ChartRepository
classes.description: Singleton class that manages a list of chart identifiers, providing methods for access, modification, and event listener creation.

classes.name: ChartRepository.ChartRepositoryListener
classes.description: Interface for listeners interested in digital chart events.

classes.name: ChartScrollControl
classes.description: A class instantiated within ChartRepository to provide scrolling controls, not defined within this file.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ChartRepository.

methods.name: getChart
methods.description: Retrieves a chart identifier by index with bounds checking.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the current number of charts stored.

methods.name: addChart
methods.description: Adds a new chart identifier to the repository.

methods.name: createControls
methods.description: Creates a new ChartScrollControl with a specified listener.
